_comment: Question bank for the 'Model reliability report' in the live viewer. Each item has one clearly-correct short answer and one plausible wrong answer a model might give. trust_answer generates a chain of thought, forces a 'Final answer:', resamples the reasoning N times, and compares how sure the model sounded to how often its own reasoning actually lands on that answer. Terse answers keep probes.pick_answer reliable.
